Usage: gufo serve embedding [OPTIONS]

Serve EmbeddingGemma 2 text embeddings.

Model:
  -m, --model <DIR>          EmbeddingGemma 2 model directory
      --served-model-name <NAME> Public API model ID (default: embeddinggemma-2)

Server:
  -i, --host <IP>            Bind address
  -p, --port <N>             Port to listen on
      --max-connections <N>  Maximum simultaneous HTTP connections
      --max-request-bytes <N> Maximum HTTP request body bytes
      --api-key <KEY>        API key
      --arbiter <HOST:PORT>  Report to this gufo arbiter and follow its GPU grants
      --sse-ping-interval <N> Seconds a stream may stay silent before a ping (-1 disables)

Logging:
      --log-level <LEVEL>    Log verbosity: error, warn, info or debug (default: info)
  -v, --verbose              Shorthand for --log-level=debug

General:
  -h, --help                 Print help
